detail.command:
set -euo pipefail
printf '%s\n' '--- clean status ---'
git status --short
printf '%s\n' '--- npm ci ---'
npm ci
printf '%s\n' '--- typecheck ---'
npm run typecheck
printf '%s\n' '--- tests ---'
npm test -- --runInBand
printf '%s\n' '--- metro production bundle ---'
rm -rf /tmp/delete2-bundle /tmp/delete2-assets
mkdir -p /tmp/delete2-bundle /tmp/delete2-assets
npx react-native bundle --platform android --dev false --entry-file index.js --bundle-output /tmp/delete2-bundle/index.android.bundle --assets-dest /tmp/delete2-assets
printf '%s\n' '--- android assembleDebug ---'
cd android
./gradlew assembleDebug
printf '%s\n' '--- final status ---'
cd ..
git status --short
